projectDescription: An unofficial Python SDK and CLI for Google NotebookLM providing full programmatic access—including features not exposed in the web UI—via Python, CLI, and AI agent integrations.
keyFeatures: Full programmatic access to Google NotebookLM via Python async API and CLI
Generate Audio Overviews (podcasts), videos, slide decks, quizzes, flashcards, infographics, data tables, and mind maps
Add sources from URLs, YouTube, files (PDF, text, Markdown, Word, audio, video, images), and Google Drive
Download all generated artifacts locally (MP3, MP4, PDF, PNG, CSV, JSON, Markdown)
AI agent integration for Claude Code, Codex, and other LLM agents via bundled skill files
Web and Drive research agents with auto-import of discovered sources
Programmatic notebook sharing and user permission management
Features beyond the web UI: batch downloads, quiz/flashcard export, mind map JSON extraction, PPTX slide download, slide revision
CI/CD support via NOTEBOOKLM_AUTH_JSON environment variable
Multi-profile support for managing multiple Google accounts
publicApiSurface: notebooklm login / list / create / use / ask / summary
notebooklm source add / add-research / fulltext / guide
notebooklm generate audio / video / quiz / flashcards / slide-deck / report / mind-map
notebooklm download audio / video / quiz / flashcards / slide-deck / mind-map
